title: Individual Dispatcher Entries
statement: Let $code$ be a finite instruction list and $disp,n$ natural numbers. If the dispatcher for $n$ procedures is a prefix of the code beginning at $disp$, then for every $j<n$, the decrement-and-branch pair for procedure $j$ is a prefix of the code beginning at $disp+2j$.
hypotheses_covered: The dispatcher for $n$ procedures is a prefix of the code beginning at $disp$
